synthesis: The proposed header faithfully instantiates the source-implicit deterministic-depth bridge for the actual stopped PBPS recursion. It derives prefix causality, past measurability, unchanged unused-tail law, independence and unnormalized history-event factorization as conclusions. It neither assumes independence nor claims A.7 or random-physical-time memorylessness.

objects.source: Fixed-reference flow/bounce process driven by independent unit exponential thresholds, with generated event-time/post-bounce-state history and unused input clocks.
objects.candidate: Finite-dimensional real inner-product space E; explicit center, harmonic flow, reflection, intensity, integrated hazard, hitting time, tagged finite-or-stopped records; raw real product-clock space; finite history and raw real tail.
objects.decision: Matches the local probability substrate; the finite-dimensional inner-product presentation includes the source Euclidean setting.

domains.source: Fixed y and reference point in Euclidean position space, fixed initial position/momentum, nonnegative physical waiting times and independent positive clocks almost surely.
domains.candidate: y,xRef:E; z0:E times E; wait/time in NNReal with top; finite records in a tagged sum; P is the countable product of real Exp(1) measures; thresholds use Real.toNNReal of raw clocks.
domains.decision: Faithful under P, since raw unit exponentials are positive almost surely. Real.toNNReal supplies an ambient extension on nonpositive raw coordinates; it must be described as a null-set coordinate extension, not the author's negative-clock dynamics.

quantifiers.source: Each deterministic finite event depth before iterating event-time factors, with fixed parameters/initial state.
quantifiers.candidate: For all fixed y,xRef,z0,n, all clock streams w,w' for prefix causality, and every measurable finite-history event A for restriction/pushforward factorization.
quantifiers.decision: Correct deterministic-depth scope. Fin(n+1) includes record depths 0 through n, not n+1 consumed clocks.

assumptions.source: Paper-wide C2 potential, positive lower Hessian constant, ordered lower/upper Hessian constants, upper Hessian bound, positive scale and beta*eta<=1. Independent unit exponentials are the supplied probability model.
assumptions.candidate: hAlpha positivity, hAlphaBeta order, hV C2, hH both quadratic Hessian bounds, hEta positivity, hBetaEta upper scale range; standard finite-dimensional/Borel carrier data. Product measure constructs iid inputs internally. No history measurability, past dependence, independence or tail law is a hypothesis.
assumptions.decision: No excess source-facing mathematical premise. Some analytic hypotheses exceed the needs of abstract iid independence but are retained from the actual source process. All probability ingredients are internal dependencies/conclusions.

conclusion.source: Implicit unchanged independent unused clocks at each finite generated prefix, needed to iterate the exponential construction.
conclusion.candidate: Ambient history/tail measurability; prefix causality; history measurability in past n; tail pushforward equals P; IndepFun(history,tail); joint pushforward equals history-law product P; for each measurable A the tail pushforward under restricted P equals P(history in A) scaled P.
conclusion.decision: A mathematically appropriate explicit strengthening of the source-implicit substrate. The final identity is unnormalized and valid even for zero-mass A; it does not assert pointwise conditional probabilities.

scopes_senses.source: Finite recursion depth, including histories where recursion has already stopped; no arbitrary history or unproved random-index restart.
scopes_senses.candidate: Fixed n history, first n raw coordinates only; tail n is w(n+k); stopped branch remains absorbing. past n is the sigma algebra generated by coordinate maps for k<n.
scopes_senses.decision: Exactly the needed deterministic-prefix sense. Source E_(n+1) corresponds to raw w n; no off-by-one error. Restriction identities condition on measurable finite-history events without normalizing.

constant_dependencies.source: Unit clock rate is fixed; no probability error or horizon-dependent constant in this independence ingredient.
constant_dependencies.candidate: Unit rate in expMeasure 1; no additional constants, bounded-rate premise or random horizon.
constant_dependencies.decision: Matches. Energy-cap/non-explosion constants are deliberately absent from this local substrate and remain separate consumers.

literal_algorithm_audit.decision: c=y-eta*gradient(V,xRef); position harmonic arc and momentum coefficient -sin(t)/sqrt(eta) agree with the source for eta>0.

Reflection subtracts twice the component in the gradient-difference direction. At zero normal, real division by zero gives zero multiplier and therefore identity reflection, matching R0=I. Rate is sqrt(eta) times the positive part of the momentum/gradient-difference inner product.

Lambda integrates the literal rate along the literal flow from 0 to nonnegative t; hittingAfter into Ici 0 with start zero is the first Lambda-e>=0 crossing and carries top for an empty crossing set. No finite-crossing premise is added.

Top crossing produces a stopped tag and leaves subsequent tags stopped. Otherwise the finite time is added and the flowed state bounced. untopD 0 occurs only behind the non-top branch, so the fallback is not assigned source meaning at infinite time.

record at depth j consumes raw coordinates 0 through j-1. history indexed by Fin(n+1) therefore consumes precisely the prefix k<n; tail begins at raw n, the source E_(n+1). The stopped branch does not acquire future-clock information.

Countable product Exp(1) realizes the source independent clock model. The law/independence conclusions follow only after proving measurable finite-prefix dependence and disjoint coordinate-block independence; their proofs are not presumed by this header decision.

source_proof_dependency_mapping.S87-I1: Explicit ambient history measurability, prefix causality and past n measurability are conclusions for the literal stopped recursion.
source_proof_dependency_mapping.S87-I2: The product P fixes the independent-input law; deriving the tail law and block independence is a proof obligation.
source_proof_dependency_mapping.S87-I3: Explicit tail-law, IndepFun, joint pushforward and restricted-tail factorization conclusions.
source_proof_dependency_mapping.S87-I4: OPEN: conditional evaluation at the random integrated hazard is absent.
source_proof_dependency_mapping.S87-I5: OPEN: finite-event density, infinite-wait mass/final survival, iteration and countable A.7 assembly are absent.

publication_boundary.classification: Source-implicit reusable probability dependency for the actual finite PBPS history; not a printed standalone PBPS theorem.
publication_boundary.allowed_header_claim: The sealed target accurately describes the deterministic-depth unused-tail substrate of G86-11.
publication_boundary.post_compile_requirement: A fresh exact-body reviewer packet plus independent source-blind reconstruction and all required semantic/publication checks remain mandatory. Do not replay this header decision as body acceptance.
